visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: List, Dict and Set Comprehensions
visualizerParams.description: A comprehension builds a list, dictionary or set from a loop in one expression, optionally with a condition.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
squares = [n * n for n in range(1, 6)]
evens = [n for n in squares if n % 2 == 0]
lengths = {word: len(word) for word in ["apple", "fig", "kiwi"]}
unique_lengths = {len(word) for word in ["apple", "fig", "kiwi", "plum"]}
print(squares, evens)
print(lengths)
print(sorted(unique_lengths))
